summary: Tested the new 'Synchroniser avec une autre version' feature (sync between deployments). Backend: 10 pytest cases on /api/admin/sync/* (export-token RBAC, export gzip dump, import validation + full self-sync). Frontend: full Playwright flow on /console/parametres?tab=donnees (sync-card → sync-gen-token → sync-token-box → sync-src/code/pin → confirm → sync-result). Preview products=38, users=11 confirmed. App still fully functional after two self-imports (admin login works, 38 products listed, orders present).

minor.issue: On wrong PIN, the error branch runs AFTER the request body is read but BEFORE the source_url/token validation. That is fine, but if `user['id']` has no attendance_code set, response is a generic 'PIN admin invalide' even when PIN is correct-but-missing in DB. Low risk — admin seed sets 1234.
No audit log of who performed the destructive import; only the print to stdout via FastAPI logs. Consider persisting an entry in a `sync_history` collection.

Endpoint is NOT behind require_role; relies solely on bearer token in query string. This is by design (so another instance can fetch) but token leakage via query logs is a concern. Consider also accepting token via header.

issues: After successful import, UI advises 'Déconnectez-vous puis reconnectez-vous' but does NOT force logout. If an admin keeps using the stale session (user record may have changed id/password hash after import), they may hit 401s silently. Consider auto-logout on success.

action_items: Consider forcing logout on client after successful import (frontend SyncCard)
Consider adding a sync_history audit collection on import
Optional: accept export token via Authorization header too (to avoid query-string logging)
critical_code_review_comments: sync.py is small, focused, and reads cleanly. SKIP set correctly excludes sync_tokens from export AND re-create loop.
Good: validates https:// prefix, token presence, source reachability (502), and parses with json_util for bson types.
Good: PIN compared against the admin's own attendance_code (not a shared secret).
Minor: `dump = json_util.loads(...)` could raise on huge payloads — currently fine (gzip stream < 10 MB for Chez Dina) but no size cap.
seed_data_creation: None. Backend tests performed 2 self-imports of the preview DB (source=destination). Counts verified: products=38, users=11, 57 collections.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login inputs on /console/connexion are type='text' (not email) with data-testid 'login-email', 'login-password', 'login-punch-toggle' (checkbox 'Pointer mon arrivée'). After login, URL redirects to /console (not /console/dashboard). A guided tour modal appears — close via button:has(svg.lucide-x). Sync feature test ids: sync-card, sync-gen-token, sync-token-box, sync-token, sync-src, sync-code, sync-pin, sync-import, sync-result. Backup still at /tmp/dump.gz if needed.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature-addition testing, not a bug RCA. All acceptance criteria from the review request were met.
